name: Community drivetrain controllers
platform: Hyundai / Kia classic CAN; Subaru Global platform
author: OpenTune contributors
description: The first community definition pack and the worked example of docs/PACK-AUTHORING.md: three drivetrain controller definitions that are not in the built-in ctrldefs/ set - the Hyundai / Kia TCU (TCU11-TCU13 broadcast, UDS 0x7E1), the Hyundai / Kia 4WD coupling controller (_4WD11-_4WD13 broadcast plus ABS wheel speeds) and the Subaru Global platform transmission (Transmission / CVT broadcast plus wheel speeds, UDS 0x7E1). Signal layouts are transcribed from opendbc (MIT); diagnostic ids come from opendbc's firmware-query fingerprints and ISO 15765-4. Evidence: synthetic-tested - every frame is decoded from synthetic payloads built independently of the files (crates/opentune-packs/tests/community_drivetrain.rs); the UDS channels are untested (implemented) and nothing has been checked against a real car or capture. Meanings beyond the upstream DBC names and scales are marked per signal; checksums are not verified.
sources: commaai/opendbc opendbc/car/hyundai/{values,fingerprints}.py and opendbc/car/subaru/{values,fingerprints}.py @ 27fa1c5d8eed (MIT): platforms, transmission request ids, identification requests
ISO 15765-4 (response id = request id + 8, 500 kbit/s OBD-II CAN rate)
